supplement: Evidence transport and process grouping only; arithmetic, gates, fixtures, observers unchanged.
entry: Same final probe/DSP/Host bytes. Both complete standalone pilot permits and complete single/dual pilot permits before cohort. Cohort does not select or tune arithmetic.
backend_lifetime: One OS process per cohort. Each role creates/tears down its own QNN backend/device/context, retaining immutable packages and fixtures. Fresh safety preflight once before this OS process, then two-second foreground monitoring throughout all roles.
raw_container: Little endian words header 0x42524301,version1,role_count5,forward_limit60. Each role: modecode,uint64 byte_count low/high words, then unchanged complete 0x42525001 evidence bytes. No lossy conversion. Device raw SHA, gzip SHA, pull SHA, decompressed SHA checked. Exclusive derived role files independently rehashed against verified container.
stdout: cohort_begin,mode=... and cohort_end,mode=...,exit=0 delimit each role's own full API/numerical/teardown evidence. Overall process exit captured before raw readback. Any nonzero role stops cohort and forbids formal PASS.
digest: Each role retains numerical identities and output-word digest, excluding timers/receipts/counters/process identity. Compare same role across three independent OS processes. All role coverage and final process completion required.
